capabilities: Run multi-step agent tasks that search, read, draft, edit, and organize vault notes
Attach files or selected passages to ground agent requests in context
Configure BYOK model providers or download Catea Lite for offline local chat
Store reusable memory, personas, skills, and MCP tool connections
Write a daily diary entry per persona from completed conversations
extras: Freemium: BYOK is free, while the hosted Catea Pro subscription is not currently offered in the plugin UI pending service verification. Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.8.0+); mobile is not supported. GPL-3.0 licensed; no telemetry. Bash tool access is disabled by default and can reach files outside the vault when enabled. The diary feature exists in source but is not yet in a published release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to delegate multi-step research, drafting, and file-organization tasks to an AI agent that works directly on vault files.

relations.evidence: Built on open-source work including CatUI, ANNO, and Tabler Icons.
Web search and page reading use Exa, Jina, or DuckDuckGo.

requires.name: OpenAI-, Anthropic-compatible provider, provider preset, or OpenRouter key

summary: AI agent with a paper-style workspace that searches, reads, drafts, and organizes vault notes, using BYOK model providers or local inference.
